prompt: Write an fq for category_s=electronics tagged as CAT (so a facet can later exclude it). One-line fq only.
notes: Tag goes on fq via {!tag=NAME}; exclude is separate on the facet

prompt: Write a JSON Facets terms facet on category_s (limit 20) that excludes the filter tagged CAT. Just the facet object body.

Write a complete JSON Request body for /query with: main query *:*, two filters — category_s=electronics tagged CAT and status_s=active untagged. Two facets: by_category on category_s ignoring CAT, by_brand on brand_s. JSON only.
notes: Canonical multi-select: tag on one fq + exclude in matching facet, other facet scoped

prompt: Write a JSON Facets terms facet on brand_s that excludes filter tagged CAT. Just the facet body.
notes: Correct key is excludeTags. Solr silently ignores excludeFilters/exclude/ex

prompt: Can the tag/exclude mechanism be used to exclude the main query (q) from a facet's count? One-sentence answer.
notes: Tag/exclude only works on fq/filter, never on q

prompt: I'm using the legacy facet API (facet.field, NOT JSON Facets). Write the parameters: tagged fq for category_s=electronics tag CAT, and facet.field on category_s that excludes that tag. Just URL params.
notes: Legacy API uses {!ex=TAG} on facet.field; JSON Facets uses domain.excludeTags

prompt: Write a JSON Facets terms facet on color_s that excludes both CAT and PRICE tagged filters. Just the facet body.
notes: excludeTags accepts array or comma-separated string

prompt: I have fq={!tag=CAT}category_s:electronics. Write the JSON Facets domain section that excludes this filter exactly. Tag name must match.
notes: Tag names are case-sensitive: CAT and cat are different

prompt: Main query returns parents (type_s:product). Filters: brand_s=Nike tagged BRAND on parent. Write a child-scope facet on color_s (sku attribute) that excludes BRAND tag. Just the facet body.
notes: domain can combine blockChildren and excludeTags simultaneously
